items.quote: What is the maximum sustained wind speed recorded during the storm with the highest maximum storm category?
items.description: 找出 max_storm_cat 最高的風暴（平手取檔案序首列），回傳該列 max_sust_wind，即為最高類別風暴的最大持續風速。

items.quote:
Put each answer item on its own line, in the form `@name[value]`, using exactly the
